description: Rules for regenerating Friends of Opus Formosa static OPENTIX seat maps. OPENTIX admin/public seat data remains the source of truth for non-pulled seats. sectionOverrides is only for special non-ticketable areas; pulledSeatRecords is the source of truth for internally controlled Friends VIP seats and must resolve to explicit floor/row/number seats. All other unavailable seats are treated as OPENTIX public sold/unavailable. Do not store OPENTIX credentials or tokens in this file; use local environment variables or GitHub Actions secrets.

rulePrecedence.appliesTo: all fetched seats, sections, prices, youth seats, reserved seats, unavailable seats, and excluded seats
any seat whose OPENTIX public status is explicitly available
rulePrecedence.effect: block legacy section-level VIP overrides; confirmed pulledSeatRecords remain the explicit internal-seat source

rulePrecedence.appliesTo: explicit floor/row/number seats matched by pulledSeatRecords.seatSelectors
rulePrecedence.effect: override OPENTIX display data with the record display as an internally controlled Friends VIP seat

rulePrecedence.appliesTo: seats matched by pulledSeatRecords.seatSelectors during internal admin import
rulePrecedence.effect: mark confirmed internally pulled seats as internal-controlled; assignmentRecords may later assign them to a named recipient

rulePrecedence.appliesTo: any Friends VIP seat matched by seatStatusOverrides.match.seatSelectors
rulePrecedence.effect: keep the Friends VIP style and add a taken marker so the seat is visibly crossed out
if a public seat's OPENTIX status is no longer available, keep its public ticket-section style and add a taken marker

publicSeatStatusOverlay.effect: Use public OPENTIX seat status as the availability source because it updates sold/unavailable seats more reliably than the admin sections/seats response. Seat sections, prices, and SVG still come from the admin API.
